title: content/climate.yaml — terrain transition table + climate tuning rates (CA1-3, D4/D10)
description: The single owner of climate DATA (docs/plans/climate.md RESOLVED #4 + §1c CA1-3). Two blocks: `transitions` (from-type × condition-Formula → to-type, the §6-DSL dynamic-terrain rules consumed by engine/env/climate.Rules) and `balance` (rate + annual-°C + wind tuning, D9 spirit). UPDATED to CA1-3: `temperature` is ACTUAL °C (NOT clamped) with an annual sinusoid (CA1 annual_mid/amp/phase) + a daily °C delta + a world-uniform wind (CA2 wind_*); the old normalized-[0,1] temperature model is superseded. The 10d-expected/30d-forced/2-12h-duration rain SHAPE is fixed design in engine code — only the rates here are tunable. COARSE-GRID GEOMETRY (cols/rows) + world bounds live in content/world.yaml (grids.climate_grid_cols/rows + bounds), injected into climate.Config by platform/config — NOT here. platform/config compiles this into climate.Rules + the climate.Config rates and cross-checks every from/to against content/terrain.yaml (an undefined terrain id is a load-time failure, D10).

init.description: Initial per-cell climate state seeds (CA3). Grid GEOMETRY (cols/rows/bounds) is content/world.yaml's, not here.

initial_moisture.description: Optional default starting Moisture for every cell ([0,1], clamped); defaults to 0.5 when absent (climate.Config.InitMoisture).

initial_temperature.description: Optional default starting Temperature in °C (CA3 — NOT clamped, sub-zero allowed); defaults to ≈ annual_mid when absent (climate.Config.InitTemperature).

transitions.description: The from-type × condition → to-type transition table (D4/D10). Order is SIGNIFICANT: for a given `from`, the FIRST rule whose `when` Formula is true wins (deterministic, D12). An empty array = climate-off (outcome-neutral introduction phase, RESOLVED #10). Every `from` and ordinary `to` MUST be a terrain id defined in content/terrain.yaml; the reserved thaw target `__origin__` is exempt (platform/config validates).

balance.description: Tuning injected into climate.Config (D9 spirit: rates/constants are content, the rain SHAPE is fixed design). Rain rates (1a) + the annual-°C cycle constants (CA1) + the daily-°C deltas (CA3) + the world-uniform wind random-walk params (CA2). The fixed-design hard values (hard-cap 720h, duration 2-12h) are carried here ONLY so engine code stays literal-free (D10).

ice_type.description: Optional terrain id water freezes into (ICE). When present platform/config cross-checks it against terrain.yaml; absence means ice modelling is disabled.

rain_prob_per_hour.description: Per-game-hour increment to PRain, calibrated so E[first rain] ≈ 10 days = 240 game-hours (1a).

rain_hard_cap_hours.description: Forced rain after this many dry game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 720 (30 days); injected to keep engine literal-free (D10).

rain_dur_min_hours.description: Rain duration lower bound in game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 2 (1a).

rain_dur_max_hours.description: Rain duration upper bound in game-hours. FIXED DESIGN = 12 (1a); must be ≥ rain_dur_min_hours.

moisture_rain_rate.description: Moisture gained per game-hour while raining (1a).

evap_base_rate.description: Base Moisture lost per dry game-hour, temperature-independent (1a).

evap_temp_scale.description: EXTRA Moisture lost per dry game-hour PER °C of positive Temperature — the Temperature→Moisture feedback, per-°C units (CA3, floored at 0 in engine; NO [0,1] clamp now).

annual_mid.description: °C annual midline — the year-cycle center (CA1; e.g. 12.5).

annual_amp.description: °C annual amplitude — annual_mid ± annual_amp spans the yearly swing (CA1; e.g. 17.5 ⇒ ≈ −5…30 °C).

annual_phase.description: φ radians — aligns the sin peak with summer YearFraction / trough with winter (CA1).

temp_day_peak.description: °C DELTA added at the daily peak (midday), POSITIVE, around the annual midline (CA3).

temp_night_low.description: °C DELTA added at the daily trough (night), NEGATIVE, around the annual midline (CA3; ≤ 0).

wind_prevailing_dir.description: Prevailing wind direction Dir reverts toward, radians [0,2π) (CA2).

wind_dir_drift.description: Per-step seeded random-walk step scale for wind Dir, radians (CA2).

wind_dir_reversion.description: Fraction Dir is pulled back toward wind_prevailing_dir each step — mean-reverting [0,1] (CA2).

wind_mag_noise.description: Seeded per-step magnitude-noise amplitude; resulting Mag clamped [0,1] (CA2).

snow_freeze_c.description: °C at/below which precipitation accumulates as snow (CS3, plan §1d; design value 0).

snow_accum_rate.description: SnowCover ∈[0,1] gained per game-hour of freezing precipitation (CS3).

snow_melt_rate.description: SnowCover lost per game-hour PER °C above snow_freeze_c — temperature-proportional melt (CS3).

terrainId.description: A terrain type id; must exist in content/terrain.yaml (cross-checked by platform/config, D10).

to.description: A terrain id, or the reserved ICE thaw sentinel __origin__. platform/config performs the referential/sentinel cross-check.

when.description: A §6 Formula boolean condition over CellState operands `moisture` ([0,1]) and `temperature` (**°C**, CA3 — thresholds are °C, e.g. "temperature < 0" or "moisture > 0.7 & temperature > 20"). Compiled + validated by platform/config via the shared engine/kernel/expr Formula evaluator; an undefined operand is a load-time failure (D10/design.md §6). No RNG inside a condition (deterministic, D12).
